plan: [This is a sealed-bid Vickrey (second-price) auction with three bidders. Truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy: bidding your private value ($6) maximizes expected payoff because the winning price equals the second-highest bid independent of your stated maximum. No prior history to adjust; submit bid = $6.]

[Value is $40. In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: you win iff the second-highest bid < $40 and then pay that bid, yielding nonnegative expected profit. Overbidding can cause losses; underbidding can miss positive-profit wins. No prior rounds to learn from. Ties are random and may yield zero profit, but truth-telling remains optimal. Hence bid your true valuation of $40.]
